mapper.select: SELECT u.ucode FROM `user` u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM weight_log w WHERE w.ucode = u.ucode AND w.logged_at = CURDATE() )

SELECT u.ucode FROM `user` u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM roulette_log r WHERE r.ucode = u.ucode AND r.spin_type = 'FREE' ) OR ( SELECT MAX(r.spun_at) FROM roulette_log r WHERE r.ucode = u.ucode AND r.spin_type = 'FREE' ) < NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR )
SELECT u.ucode FROM `user` u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.streak_count > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM weight_log w WHERE w.ucode = u.ucode AND w.logged_at = CURDATE() )
